controlled_controls.name: Exact record versus related records
controlled_controls.expected: AC criteria+test_spec requires original AC records, excluding proved Test-result operations; a separate linked-Test request retains a matching Test-result operation. Description changes alone cannot change fit.

controlled_controls.name: Population contract versus saved prose
controlled_controls.expected: A recipe with authoritative exact-record result population is incompatible with descendants despite descendant-sounding prose. Missing authoritative metadata remains unknown, never proved descendants/completeness or excluded solely for that absence.

controlled_controls.name: Unknown, hydratable and bounded candidates
controlled_controls.expected: Unknown legacy metadata, source-hydratable fields absent from projection, and possible truncation each remain eligible/unknown; none converts later incomplete evidence into a complete answer.

controlled_controls.name: Zero remaining operations
controlled_controls.expected: All candidates proved incompatible yields ordinary choice.operation unsupported, knowledge_status unsupported, partial/unavailable coverage, zero paid operation-selection calls, queries, requests or new assessments; local absence does not prove every route unsupported.

controlled_controls.name: One candidate does not bypass Jev
controlled_controls.expected: One eligible or unknown operation still receives exactly one operation-selection judgment and unchanged gates; existing target/answerability decisions are separate.

controlled_controls.name: Probability/confidence boundaries
controlled_controls.expected: 0.7999/0.64 refuses; 0.80/0.64 permits; 0.90/0.49 refuses. Preserve choice.operation uncertain and knowledge_selection uncertain; knowledge_status selection_uncertain is diagnostic only. Refusal retains one paid selection usage, partial/unavailable coverage, zero queries/requests/assessments.

controlled_controls.name: Sibling merge and resume
controlled_controls.expected: Real uncertainty or ordinary unsupported output merges with independently fulfilled sibling evidence through real guard/public continuation without new assessment conflicts/veto. Existing established unsupported_population remains the distinct completeness-guard control.

controlled_controls.name: Explicit query compatibility
controlled_controls.expected: Valid explicit operation keeps deterministic validation/execution without new semantic selection; malformed explicit operation remains existing validation error.

controlled_controls.name: Missing user meaning
controlled_controls.expected: Genuinely missing required root/levels/inclusion retains focused clarification; a sufficient request refused only by model confidence never asks the user to repair model uncertainty.

controlled_controls.name: Scope and catalog identity
controlled_controls.expected: Saved choice retains name/version/digest/validated arguments and all original identities, fields, source/read roots/revision and cumulative budgets; five/seven positional GraphOffer callers remain compatible.

controlled_controls.name: Pre-call wire budget
controlled_controls.expected: Fit facts cross the existing packet limit in a discriminating fixture; pre-call budget refusal occurs with zero provider charge/query, without trimming original obligations.

controlled_controls.name: Distinct failures
controlled_controls.expected: Invalid/unoffered choice, provider failure, denied access and exhausted budget keep their distinct failures/paid usage; no blind retry, forced clarification, forced sole candidate or global assessment veto.
